**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

No non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binds Northwind anywhere in the MSA. Targeted searches for "solicit", "induce", "employ or engage", "no-hire", "recruit", "employee" and "personnel" returned only Vendor-side staffing, confidentiality and indemnity references — nothing restrictive on Customer. § 12.3 goes further and expressly preserves Customer's freedom to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment. That satisfies the preferred element outright, so no redline was proposed.
